name: Classic Round Natural Diamond Split Shank Ring
subtitle: 2 CT Natural Round Brilliant · 14K White Gold
summary: A 2.00 ct round brilliant natural diamond in a delicate 14K white gold split-shank setting, with natural pavé diamonds along the shoulders.
description:
A classic round brilliant diamond with a graceful opening along the band. The 2.00 ct natural centre diamond is complemented by slender split-shank shoulders set with approximately 0.30–0.50 ct of natural pavé diamonds.

Crafted in high-polish 14K white gold, the delicate split band draws the eye to the centre stone. The approximate total diamond weight is 2.30–2.50 ct.

$17,000 CAD. The centre diamond is offered in the D–E colourless range with VS clarity. Exact colour, clarity and grading report are confirmed with the selected diamond. Band diamond weight may vary slightly with ring size. The separate band shown in the supplied styling photos is not included.
